correctness.rationale: For r,d>=1, zero-extended backward r-th difference D:C^d→C^{d+r} has SPD Gram Toeplitz H_ij=(-1)^(i-j)binom(2r,r+i-j) for |i−j|<=r. Sharp point evaluation is G_jj=(H^{-1})_jj by Hilbert Cauchy–Schwarz; equality sequences are nonzero complex multiples of Ge_j. An explicit first inverse column c_j=R_{r−1}(j)R_r(d−j+1)/((r−1)!R_r(d+r)) solves Hc=e1 via degree 2r−1 discrete polynomial and exact boundary correction. Gohberg–Semencul Toeplitz identity gives G_{j+1,j+1}−G_jj=(d−2j)R_{r−1}(j+1)²R_{r−1}(d−j+1)²/(((r−1)!)²R_{2r−1}(d+1)). This proves central maximal indices and positive sum formula for all orders and lengths; Riemann sum yields C_r,d~d^{r−1/2}/(2^{2r−1}(r−1)!sqrt(2r−1)). Independently inverted exactly all H for r=1..6,d=1..13 and matched entire first column, diagonal, and central maximum. Finite tests corroborate proof, not infinite order.
residual_risks: Zero extension and full index range 1..d+r are essential; alternative end conditions yield different Gram and constants.
